description: Canonical OpenObserve RUM stream (view/action/error/resource/long_task/vital events from @openobserve/browser-rum). No per-service/per-environment/custom RUM stream is ever created — see docs/openobserve-stream-schema-lifecycle.md.
notes: data_retention:7 and max_query_range:168 are lab-only desired values, verified writable/readable against the pinned OpenObserve v0.91.0 API (see docs/openobserve-v0.91-stream-capabilities.md, capability #7/#8/#9). They are NOT a production default — production retention is an explicit open company decision (REQUIRED_COMPANY_DECISION) and must never be auto-applied outside this lab.

store_original_data stays false: enabling it exposes a raw, un-sanitized pre-flatten '_original' column that bypasses the sanitization sanitization pipeline's field-level redaction (verified — see capability #10). Any drift to true on this stream is SECURITY_DRIFT.

full_text_search_keys/index_fields/bloom_filter_fields/partition_keys are left at the server default (empty/off) pending a real correlation query-profile measurement — see docs/openobserve-stream-schema-lifecycle.md#index-and-partition-decision. No custom index/partition is applied without measured benefit.

distinct_value_fields is the one exception: ['service','env'] is an explicit, narrow allowlist (not the empty default) because this pinned OpenObserve build's distinct_value_fields is additive-only and cannot be reverted to empty once populated (verified on a disposable stream — docs/openobserve-v0.91-stream-capabilities.md capability #11a). Both fields are bounded, single-value identity fields in this lab (tests/fixtures/apps/browser-app/src/identity.js), not unbounded/high-cardinality data. Any other value here — a third field added, a field removed, or a different order — is still real INDEX_DRIFT and is refused by lab:streams:provision (scripts/lab/streams/guard.js's LOW_CARDINALITY_DISTINCT_VALUE_FIELDS allowlist).
